title: 横浜スタジアム・夜のごほうび球場グルメリール
scene: 夕暮れの横浜スタジアム。20代女性がベイスターズカラーのユニを着て、照明キラキラの観客席で名物シウマイやポテトを手に持ち笑顔。ビール片手に友だちと「乾杯」して、美味しそうに頬張るリアルな瞬間をスマホ撮影風で切り取る。
caption:
観戦の楽しさって、やっぱり球場グルメから始まる気がする🍟💕
横浜スタジアムの夜は、ライトアップと潮風と美味しいものが最高のご褒美。シウマイやポテトを友だちとシェアしながら『乾杯！』ってする時間、本当に癒されるんだよね。
一人観戦でも、好きなグルメ片手に気ままにのんびり過ごせるのも◎。
野球好きな友だちと来るのも、推しと過ごす自分時間も、どっちもアリ。
『横浜スタジアムで食べるならコレ！』っていうおすすめグルメ、みんなの推しもぜひコメントで教えてほしいな🥰
この投稿、今度の観戦に向けて保存しておくのもアリかも！
hashtags: #ビール好きな人と繋がりたい

prompts.kling: A photorealistic vertical 9:16 video, 10-15 seconds, shot with a smartphone handheld look. Show two Japanese women in their 20s, natural makeup, stylish like fashion magazine models, at Yokohama Stadium during a night game. Soft white, beige, pastel pink, and light blue tones. Start with them standing in the soft-lit stands at sunset, holding signature stadium foods like shumai and fries. One takes a bite, the other lifts a beer. They laugh and do a gentle 'cheers'. The background is full of glowing stadium lights and the lively crowd. Natural handheld camera, no AI artifacts or overlays.
prompts.veo:
Scene 1 (0-5s): Handheld shot pans across Yokohama Stadium at dusk, focusing on two fashionable Japanese women in their 20s in pastel casuals, holding stadium food (shumai, fries).
Scene 2 (5-10s): Medium shot — one woman takes a happy bite, the other raises her drink. They look at each other, smiling, capturing a candid, relaxed vibe. Stadium lights softly glow in the background.
Scene 3 (10-15s): Close-up — the two gently clink their drinks ('cheers'), laughing naturally. Camera softly blurs the background, emphasizing their expressions. No overlays, natural lighting.
prompts.higgsfield: vertical 9:16, handheld camera with gentle pans and slow push-ins. Start with a pan of Yokohama Stadium’s evening stands, then push in to two stylish women in their 20s holding ballpark food. Camera follows as one takes a bite and the other lifts her beer; slow push-in on their 'cheers' moment, capturing natural smiles. Soft pastel color grading, realistic smartphone video look, no AI artifacts.
